name: product-loop
description: Drives product work one unit at a time: every brief, request and report understood and confirmed by the user before it is recorded, a new project's brief turned into a capability map the user confirms, new requests placed on it, reported problems sorted into bugs or new work, a decision review the user answers on time or ahead of a milestone's turn, a locked feature document, a sliced plan, then the build and bug fixes. Presents the roadmap as a slide deck.
